_meta.footprint_note: Geography (states, cities, location mix) reflects PruittHealth's real Southeast footprint. Finance, occupancy, and survey figures are illustrative synthetic data.

state_summary._note: By-state rollup recomputed from the facility roster. Geography reflects PruittHealth's real Southeast footprint; finance/occupancy/survey figures are illustrative.

citation_trend_monthly._note: New state-survey citations per month for the three categories with the clearest movement. Illustrative.

severity_scale._note: CMS scope/severity grid (letters A–L). Plain-language gloss for non-clinical readers. Higher letter = more serious.
severity_scale.A-C: No actual harm — minor deficiencies, low risk (least serious)
severity_scale.D-F: Potential for more than minimal harm — no actual harm yet
severity_scale.J-L: Immediate Jeopardy — serious harm or risk of death (most serious; fastest correction required)
